Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the meaning of “founded” by privileging VCU’s 1968 merger/creation date over the commonly cited founding year tied to its predecessor (MCV, 1838), despite official sources (e.g., VCU Bulletin snippet stating “VCU was founded in 1838…”) being available.
